videos.caption: The long awaited Lasagna Soup! 🍝 I’m finally getting around to making this viral soup and WOWWW it’s insanely good! It honestly might be my favorite soup of the series!  Let me know if you make it! Here’s how:  1/2 yellow onion, diced (about a cup) 6-8 cloves minced garlic, to taste 1/2 lb hot or mild Italian sausage (I used hot) 1/2 lb lean ground beef 2 T tomato paste Salt and pepper to taste 1-2 t Tony’s Seasoning, to taste 1 t dried basil 1 t dried parsley 1 t dried oregano 1 t Italian seasoning 1/2 t red pepper (to taste) 24 oz marinara 1/2 cup heavy cream 4-6 cups chicken stock, depending on how soupy you want it 1/2 lb Laguna noodles, broken into pieces Handful of fresh basil 1 cup parm 1 cup ricotta 1 cup mozzarella 1/4 cup fresh parsley Salt and pepper to taste 1. In a medium bowl, combine your parm, ricotta, mozzarella, parsley, salt and pepper. Set aside. 2. In a large soup pot or dutch oven, heat your olive oil over medium heat. Add in your onion, add a pinch of salt, and cook for 4 minutes.  Throw in your garlic and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds.  3. Add in your sausage and beef, breaking into pieces with a wooden spoon. Cook for a few minutes and then season with your salt, pepper, basil, oregano, parsley, Italian, red pepper, and Tony’s. Cook until no longer pink. 4. Add in your tomato paste and stir. Cook for a couple minutes. Pour in your chicken broth and marinara. Bring to a boil.  5. Pour in your lasagna pieces, reduce heat, and  simmer for about 10 minutes, or until al dente, stirring occasionally.  6. Once your noodles are done, add in your heavy cream and fresh basil (torn). Adjust seasonings if needed. Stir, serve, and top with a dollop of your ricotta mixture. Enjoy! #heresyourbite #lasagnasoup #lasagnasouprecipe #fallsoup #fallsouprecipe #fallsoupseries #fallsouprecipes #souptok #souptiktok #foodtiktok #foodtok #easyrecipe #easyrecipes #easysoup #easysouprecipes #easysouprecipe #easysoups

Had to turn my viral baked lasagne jacket into a tray bake for four … because one potato simply isn’t enough when comfort food calls 🥔😂 This is a take on my baked lasagne style jacket potato just bigger, better, and perfect for feeding four instead of one. Fluffy crispy jackets. Rich leftover Bolognese. Creamy cheesy béchamel. Finished with a golden cheese melt. Would you share this… or keep the whole tray to yourself? 👀 🥔 Lasagne-Style Jacket Potato Tray Bake Serves 4 Ingredients Jackets • 4 large baking potatoes • Olive oil spray • Sea salt & black pepper • 40g butter Filling • 600–700g leftover Bolognese sauce Cheesy Béchamel Sauce • 40g butter • 40g plain flour • 500ml semi-skimmed milk • Black pepper • 100g mixed grated cheese • 30–40g grated Parmesan For layering • 150–200g mozzarella or mixed cheese • Extra Parmesan for topping Method 1. Cook the jacket potatoes Pierce potatoes, rub with olive oil and salt. Air fry at 180°C for 45 minutes, then another 10 minutes until crispy. Oven option: 200°C for about 1 hour until fluffy inside and crunchy outside. 2. Make the cheesy béchamel Melt butter in a pan over medium heat. Stir in flour and cook for 1 minute. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth and thickened. Season with black pepper, then stir through mixed cheese and Parmesan until melted and creamy. Set aside. 3. Assemble the tray bake Place all 4 crispy jackets into a large tray. Slice open and gently mash the centres with butter, salt and pepper. 👉 Spoon 1 tablespoon of béchamel into each potato and mix through the fluffy middle. Now layer in this order: • Add the leftover Bolognese • Pour over more béchamel sauce • Sprinkle over mozzarella or mixed cheese • Finish with a generous grating of Parmesan 4. Final melt Bake at 180°C for 10–12 minutes or air fry at 180°C for 4–5 minutes until golden, bubbling and irresistible. #foryoupagе #spud #jacketpotato #jacketpotatoes #lasagna

I decided to double up on reel meals since I’m behind with editing… Loaded Chicken Twice Baked Potato!!! Nuff said. I wish y’all could taste through the screen omg. I tore this meal DOWN ——————————————— RECIPEEEE! If y'all been following me y'all know I do not measure but i'll try my best.  Ingredients:  - Russet Potatoes  - Heavy Cream - Colby Jack Cheese - Seasonings for taste (in step list)  - Sharp Cheddar Cheese  - Unsalted Butter  - Vegetable Oil - Broccoli (optional for filling) - Aluminum Foil - Garlic Paste  - Sour Cream - EVOO - Cubed Chicken (cut up breasts or tenderloin)  [Baked Potato] * 1st you want to prep your potatoes. You're basically making a baked potato. Take your potatoes (russet) and wash them. Then cover with oil (I used vegetable oil) and individually wrap each potato tightly in aluminum foil. Bake in the oven at 400 degrees F for about an hour. * Once potatoes are soft and cooked completely remove the foil and cut down the middle of each potato, hot dog style. Scoop out the inside of the potato and put into an empty mixing bowl. To the mixing bowl you're going to add 1 stick of unsalted melted butter, tbsp of garlic paste, parsley, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp garlic salt, cooked broccoli, 1/2c grated sharp cheddar cheese, pepper, and 2 tbsp sour cream. Mix together and scoop filling back into potatoes. [Sauce]  * Add 1 tbsp butter to pan, 1 tsp garlic paste and parsley and melt down. Add about 1cup of heavy cream and let cook for 5 minutes to thicken. Add pepper, onion powder and lawrys seasoning salt to season. Add colby jack cheese (about 1cup) and mix until sauce is thick and consistency you like. [Chicken]  * I used chicken beasts and cut into cubes. Add EVOO and seasoned with parsley, onion powder, garlic powder and adobo. Cooked in a greased pan until done. * Add thin layer of sauce on potatoes, then chicken, then sauce again and finally top with more cheese and bake on 125 until cheese is melted. #loadedpotato #twicebakedpotato #chickenloadedpotato #cookingtiktok #chefd #fivestarmeals #dinnerideas #dinnerinspo

crispy chicken caesar salad wrap 🌯🍽️  and thank you SO much for 500k 🫶🏽🥹   recipe:    4 chicken breasts  1 cup all-purpose flour (120g)   seasonings (to taste): salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, italian seasoning, chili powder, kinder bold chicken seasoning blend ( i used this to season the chicken and flour )    for the wet mixture : 2 eggs 2–3 tbsp heavy cream (30–45g) 1–2 tbsp pickle juice     panko: 1½ cups panko breadcrumbs (90g) 2–3 tbsp grated parmesan (optional)    other ingredients: romaine lettuce tortillas  extra parmesan oil for frying   season the chicken generously with your spices. in one bowl, mix the flour with any remaining seasoning. in another bowl, whisk the eggs, cream, and pickle juice. in a third bowl, combine the panko and parmesan. coat each piece of chicken in the flour, then the egg mixture, then press into the panko until fully coated. let the breaded chicken rest for 5–10 minutes so the coating sticks. fry in oil over medium heat until golden and cooked through, about 4–5 minutes per side. remove and let drain    caesar dressing 1 cup mayo (240g) ½ cup finely grated parmesan (50g) 2–3 cloves garlic, minced 2 tbsp lemon juice (30g) 1 tbsp dijon mustard (15g) 1 tsp worcestershire ½ tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper ¼ cup olive oil (60g) 2–4 tbsp water (to thin if needed)   for the dressing, whisk together the mayo, parmesan, garlic, lemon juice, dijon, worcestershire, salt, and pepper. slowly whisk in the olive oil, then add water as needed until smooth and pourable. toss chopped romaine with some of the dressing. assemble the wraps with dressing, lettuce, crispy chicken, & extra parmesan. wrap tightly, and enjoy.    #caesarsalad #crispychicken #wraps #EasyRecipe #Recipe

This One Pan Chicken & Gravy is an easy and delicious 30 minute dinner!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breasts  Salt, pepper, garlic powder  3 tbsp butter 3 tbsp flour  2 cups chicken broth  1/2 tsp each of salt, pepper, oregano, and thyme  1 tsp each of paprika, onion powder, garlic powder  INSTRUCTIONS  Cut chicken breasts in half lengthwise to make them thinner. Season the chicken with some salt, pepper, and garlic powder (I don’t use exact measurements for this part).  In a skillet over medium high heat melt 3 tbsp of butter. Once the butter has melted add 3 tbsp of flour and stir continuously until well combined. Let cook for a few minutes while still stirring.  Add 2 cups of chicken broth and stir well. Season with salt, pepper, oregano, thyme, paprika, onion powder, and garlic powder. Stir well and when it starts bubbling add the chicken to the skillet.  Make sure the chicken is covered in the gravy, cover with a lid, and turn the heat down to medium low. Let this cook for 12-15 minutes or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of 165 degrees. My chicken was ready in 12 minutes, but they were pretty thin.  Shred the chicken and serve over mashed potatoes! Enjoy! Let me know if you try it out.  #chickenandgravy #easyrecipe #dinner #onepanmeal #chickenrecipes

The one recipe of mine you NEED to make, ONE PAN MARRY ME CHICKEN ORZO. Life changing! 1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken breast, cut up into cubes 2 tb olive oil 4-5 cloves garlic, mashed 3/4 cup sun-dried tomatoes, in oil, drained 2 tsp italian seasoning 2 tsp paprika 1/2 tsp kosher salt 1 tsp ground black pepper 1 cup orzo 2 3/4 cups chicken broth (or water) 3/4 cup full fat coconut milk or heavy cream 2 large handfuls fresh spinach 3/4 cup parmesan cheese, freshly grated Pat chicken dry and cut into cubes. Add olive oil to a large, deep skillet over medium-high heat. Once the pan is hot, add the chicken. Stir and cook for 2-3 minutes until the edges start to cook. Add in the sun dried tomatoes, garlic, italian seasoning, paprika, salt & black pepper. Cook for 3-4 minutes more, then add the orzo and broth and stir well. Reduce heat to medium. Cover the skillet and cook for 12 minutes, removing the cover every few minutes to stir and ensure nothing sticks to the bottom of the pan. Once the orzo is cooked through, add the coconut milk/cream and spinach and stir another minute until the spinach is wilted, then add in the parmesan cheese and stir once more. Remove from heat, plate and enjoy!   #20minutedinner #easyrecipes #marrymechicken #valentinesdaydinner #easydinner

🌮 NO-DOUGH CHEESE TACOS! These crispy corn wraps are SO good 🤤 Forget traditional tortillas — this taco shell is made with just corn + cheese and gets perfectly crispy in the oven! Ingredients: For the shells: 10.5 oz (300 g) canned or cooked sweet corn, drained 3.5 oz (100 g) shredded cheese For the filling: Cream cheese Ham Tomato Fresh herbs How to make them: Spread the corn into circles on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Sprinkle generously with shredded cheese. Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 15–20 minutes, until golden and crispy. Let them cool slightly, then carefully remove from the parchment. Fill with cream cheese, ham, tomato and fresh herbs. Fold in half and enjoy! ✨ Crispy, cheesy, easy and SO satisfying! High Protein Honey Butter Chicken Alfredo Pasta🍗🍯🧀 One of the most indulgent meal preps i’ve made! The rich, sweet & savoury flavour of the chicken pairs beautifully with the light, fragrant creaminess of the pasta🤤 Macros Per Serving (5 Total) 635 Calories | 60g Protein | 55g Carbs | 18g Fat Ingredients (Makes 5) Honey Butter Chicken - 1000g Raw Chicken Breast, small cubes - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 1.5 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 2 Tsp Parsley - 2 Tsp Garlic Powder - 2 Tsp Onion Powder - 2 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 3 Tsp Olive Oil - 40g Reduced Fat Butter (for cooking + glaze) - 20g Honey (for all the chicken) - 15g Soy Sauce (for all the chicken) - 2 Tbsp Fresh Parsley, chopped • Cook chicken on medium heat for 3-4 mins each side in a single layer till golden brown and crispy • Lower the heat, then add extra butter, honey and soy sauce. Mix for 1 mins till beautifully coated Tuscan Garlic Alfredo - 30g Fresh Minced Garlic - 150g Sundried Tomatoes, drained & chopped - 1 Tbsp Italian Herbs - 1 Tsp Salt - 350-375g 1% Milk (or milk of choice) - 200g 50% Fat Cream Cheese - 60g Grated Parmesan - 2 Pieces Parmesan Rind - Optional(outer layer, adds so much flavour!) - 275g Uncooked Linguine or Fettuccine Pasta - Garnish with Parsley • Cook minced garlic and chopped sundried tomatoes on medium low heat for 3-4 mins till fragrant. Then add Italian Herbs & salt. Cook 1 extra minute • Lower the heat then add milk, cream cheese & parmesan • Stir for 2-3 mins till slightly thickened then add cooked pasta of choice If you want all my recipes in one place, check out my Digital Cookbooks with 230+ Easy Delicious High Protein Recipes👨‍🍳❤️ . . . . #honeybutter #garlicbutter #chicken #alfredo #alfredopasta #chickenalfredo #pasta #pastarecipe #chickenrecipes #highprotein #mealprep #mealprepideas #weightloss #fitness #healthyrecipes #easyrecipes #jalalsamfit

Chicken broccoli cheddar soup 🧀🥦🍂 felt a breeze outside so it’s finally soup season! Full recipe below  Ingredients - 2 tablespoons olive oil - 1 medium onion diced - 5 garlic cloves, minced - 1 shallot, minced  - 3 carrots, shredded - 4 slices bacon, diced - 4oz diced pancetta  - 2 cups chicken broth  - 1 cup whole milk - 1 cup heavy cream - 2 chicken breast, butterflied & shredded  - 4 cups broccoli florets, chopped - 2 cups shredded cheddar cheese - 2 tsp dried thyme - 2 tsp garlic powder  - 2 tsp onion powder - 1 packet of sazon - Salt and pepper to taste - 3 tbsp all-purpose flour - 2 tbsp butter Instructions  - In a large pan on medium high heat add olive oil and seasoned chicken breast. Cook for 4 minutes on each side. Pour in chicken stock, cover and cook until done and tender enough to shred. Shred chicken and sit aside - Add bacon and pancetta to large pot, cook until done remove from the pot. In the remaining grease add diced onion and cook until it becomes translucent, about 3-4 minutes. Stir in the minced garlic and cook for another 30 seconds until fragrant. - Add butter, flour, and mix until well combined. Pour in chicken broth, stir until combined. Add the carrots, and broccoli. Cook for about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 10-15 minutes  - Pour in milk, heavy cream, same seasonings from the chicken and mix until well combined. Add shredded chicken, cheddar cheese, bacon, and pancetta . Stir until well combined taste and adjust seasoning as needed with more salt and pepper. • • #broccolicheddarsoup #dinnerideas #chickensoup #soupseason #falldinner #fyp #recipes

Raising Cane’s at Home 🐔🏠 For ALL of you asking - the app link for Osta is in my bio or you can search “Osta Recipes” on the App Store or Google Play store ‼️🫶 Crispy buttermilk chicken tenders, addictive Cane’s sauce and fluffy texas toast… all at home!  For the Chicken: -2 lbs (0.9 kg) chicken breast, sliced into strips (or use tenderloins) -2 cups buttermilk -1/3 cup pickle juice -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper -Neutral oil, for frying Flour Mixture: -2 cups all-purpose flour +1/2 cup cornstarch -1 tsp baking powder -Seasonings: 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper Cane’s Sauce -1/2 cup mayonnaise -1/4 cup ketchup -2 tsp Worcestershire sauce -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp seasoning salt Instructions: 1. Slice the chicken breasts into strips about 1 inch thick and 3–4 inches long (roughly tender-sized). In a bowl, whisk together the buttermilk, pickle juice, and chicken seasonings until fully combined. Add the chicken and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight for extra tender chicken. 2. In a large bowl, combine the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and flour mixture seasonings. Mix. 3. Add neutral oil to a large pot or deep skillet until it is about 2–3 inches deep. Heat the oil to 350°F / 175°C.  Keeping the oil around this temperature ensures crispy chicken without burning the coating. 4. Drizzle a little buttermilk marinade into the flour mixture and stir to create flaky, crispy bits. Shake excess marinade off the chicken, then coat each piece thoroughly in the flour mixture. Shake off any extra flour and gently place into the hot oil. 5. Don’t touch them for the first 1–2 mins, that’s how you get the perfect crust. Fry for 7–10 mins, or until golden brown and cooked through. Transfer the chicken to a paper towel-lined rack to drain. 6. In a bowl, combine all the sauce ingredients then refrigerate.  7. Serve the chicken with a side of sauce, texas toast & crinkle fries… Enjoy :) #dinner #raisingcanes #chicken #tiktokrecipe #recipesoftiktok #dinneridea #homecooking

INGREDIENTS  2 lb boneless chicken thighs  Buffalo Wild Wings Parmesan Garlic sauce  1 tsp each salt, pepper, Italian seasoning, and onion powder  2 tsp each garlic powder and smoked paprika  Small head of broccoli, chopped  24 oz baby potatoes  1 onion, sliced  Olive oil   Parmesan cheese  INSTRUCTIONS  Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F. Spray a large sheet pan with cooking spray.  Wash the baby potatoes and quarter them. Slice an onion and chop your broccoli. Be sure to leave the broccoli in slightly larger pieces. Add all of the veggies to the sheet pan and drizzle some olive oil over them. Season the veggies with about half of the seasoning blend.  Next, add the chicken thighs to a bowl and season with the rest of the seasoning. Add enough Parmesan Garlic sauce to coat the chicken. Stir until the chicken is well coated in seasoning and sauce.  Bake at 400 degrees F for about 35 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of at least 185 degrees F. Broil for just a few minutes if desired. videos.caption: If there is one meal that belongs on your fall dinner table, it’s a cozy pot roast. Slow cooked until tender, served over creamy mashed potatoes and finished with a rich broth. It’s the ultimate comfort meal for fall 🍂 Full recipe down below, you can also find it in the link in my bio 🤎  Beef pot roast Ingredients: 	⁃	2-3 lb chuck roast 	⁃	1 medium white onion, sliced 	⁃	3 celery stalks, diced 	⁃	3 large carrots, sliced  	⁃	Bite size potatoes 	⁃	5 garlic cloves, minced 	⁃	Rosemary  	⁃	Thyme 	⁃	2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 	⁃	3 tbsp tomato paste 	⁃	2 Au jus gravy packets 	⁃	6 cups beef bone broth 	⁃	3 tbsp unsalted butter 	⁃	2 tbsp onion powder 	⁃	2 tbsp garlic powder 	⁃	Salt to taste Instructions: Wash and prep all of your vegetables. Peel and dice the carrots, slice the onion, mince the garlic, and dice the celery. Season the chuck roast to your liking. I used onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Make sure to season all sides of the roast. Add oil to a Dutch oven and sear the roast on all sides for 3–4 minutes per side. Remove the roast from the pot and set aside. Add the celery and onion to the pot and cook over medium heat until the onion has caramelized. Add the minced garlic last to prevent it from burning. Add the tomato paste, Worcestershire sauce, and gravy packets. Add ½ cup of beef broth to deglaze the pot, then pour in the remaining broth. Add the seasonings and taste to make sure everything is seasoned to your liking. Add the roast back to the pot, along with the carrots, potatoes, butter, and a bunch of rosemary and thyme tied together with butcher’s twine. Cover and place in a 350°F oven for 3 hours. About 30 minutes before the roast is finished, prepare the mashed potatoes. To assemble, add a bed of mashed potatoes to a plate, then top with the roast, potatoes, and carrots. Finish with some of the broth and fresh or dried parsley. Enjoy! 🤎 #fall #fallrecipes #potroast #cozyvibes #fallvibes

juice for the coating- 1½ cups panko breadcrumbs (90g) 2–3 tbsp grated parmesan for the caesar salad- romaine lettuce, chopped croutons extra parmesan other ingredients- 4 large croissants oil for ⇩ Full Recipe 🍗 ⇩ Macros per 1 meal prep: Protein: 40g Carbs: 87g Fat: 8g Calories: 585 Ingredients per 2 servings (makes 2 meal preps): Chicken - 1lb chicken thigh, boneless, skinless, raw - 2 tsp salt - 2 tsp black pepper - 1/4 cup cornstarch - 1/3 second spray oil - 1 tsp sesame seeds -1 green onion Soy Glaze Sauce - 2.5 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tbsp oyster sauce - 2.5 tbsp honey - 1.5 tbsp minced garlic Cucumber Salad - 2 Persian cucumbers - 2 tsp salt - 1.5 tbsp rice vinegar - 2 tsp brown sugar - 1/2 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tsp sesame seeds 1.5 cup cooked rice How to make it yourself: 1. Dice your cucumbers into thin circles. 2. Lay your chicken thighs flat, season with salt and pepper, and coat evenly with cornstarch on both sides 3. In a bowl, mixed together, soy sauce, oyster sauce, honey, and minced garlic to make your sauce. 4. On a pan coated with spray oil on medium heat, cook your chicken until golden brown, crispy on both sides, and cooked through. 5. Remove the cooked chicken from the pan and pour in your sauce to let it simmer for 45 seconds the add back in your chicken and let it coat the sauce for a minute then quickly remove. 6. In a bowl, mix together your sliced cucumbers with salt. Let it sit for 15 minutes until the excess liquid drains from the cucumbers. 7. Remove the excess liquid from the cucumbers and rinse the cucumbers with water. 8. Pat dry the cucumbers and add them into a bowl with rice vinegar, brown sugar, soy sauce, and sesame seeds and mix well to make your salad. 9. In a meal prep container, add 1/2 your steamed rice, 1/2 your cucumber salad, and 1/2 your chicken optionally topped with sesame seeds and sliced green onions. 10. Pro tip: when meal prepping to re-heat, make sure to put your salad & meat into separate ziploc bags to avoid getting the rice soggy. When ready to eat, microwave the rice with a wet paper towel first to get it steamed, then add in your meat and microwave till warm, and finally add your salad to preserve the crunch and enjoy! 📩 Save this Soy Glazed Chicken recipe to make for later! #highprotein #lowcaloriemeals #mealprep #mealplan #healthyrecipe #weightlossmeals #asianfood #chicken

Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

Slice chicken breast and thighs into cubes. Add seasonings with grated parmesan cheese and drizzle of olive oil. Mix until well coated. 2. In a pan on low heat, add light butter with seasonings. Throwback to this Honey Garlic Lemon Pepper Chicken Thighs recipe. The full recipe is posted below and can also be found in my cookbook Let’s Get Into It! Check out my cookbook through the link in my bio. Notes: If you are doubling the recipe, do not add more lemon slices to the sauce as it will become too bitter. Ingredients: •4 bone-in Chicken Thighs •2 tsp Lemon Pepper Seasoning •2 tsp Garlic Powder •2 tsp Smoked Paprika •1 tsp Kosher Salt •1 tsp Black Pepper •1 tsp Onion Powder •3 tbsp Olive Oil Sauce •2 tbsp Unsalted Butter •¼ cup Honey •4 slices of Lemon •4 tsp minced garlic •1 tbsp freshly squeezed Lemon Juice •2 tsp Low-Sodium Soy Sauce Instructions: Prepare the Chicken 1. Clean and pat the thighs dry. In a small bowl, combine the lemon pepper seasoning, garlic powder, paprika, salt, black pepper, and onion powder. Stir in the olive oil to make a seasoning paste. Fully coat the thighs with the paste, spreading it underneath the thigh skin to flavor the meat. Transfer the chicken to a zip-top bag or a container with a lid. Let the thighs marinate for at least 2 hours or up to overnight. 2. When the chicken is done marinating, preheat the oven to 425°F (215°C). Line a large baking pan or 9x13-inch (23x33cm) baking pan with foil, set a baking rack in the pan, and coat the baking rack with nonstick cooking spray. 3. Place the thighs on the rack skin side down. Bake, uncovered. for 30 minutes. Turn over the thighs and continue to bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until cooked through. The internal temperature should be at least 165°F (75°C). When cutting into the chicken near the thickest section, all of the juices should run clear. While the chicken is baking we can prepare the sauce. Prepare the Sauce 4. In a large skillet over medium-low heat, melt the butter. When the butter is melted, add the honey, lemon slices, garlic, lemon juice, soy sauce, and 1 tablespoon water. Bring the sauce to a simmer, then cook, periodically stirring the sauce until it thickens, about 5 minutes. 5. When the chicken is done, brush the sauce all over both sides and bake for an additional 5 minutes, until the sauce has browned and turned sticky. Allow the thighs to cool for 3 to 5 minutes, then enjoy! #royaleeats

Chicken alfredo tacos 🌮  For the chicken 1 lb boneless chicken breast, cut into small pieces  Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper  1 tsp smoked paprika powder  1 tbsp garlic powder  1 tsp onion powder  1/2 tsp Italian seasoning  2 tbsp lemon juice  2 tbsp oil for marinating + more for cooking For the Alfredo sauce: 2 tbsp butter 1 tbsp all purpose flour  2 cloves fresh garlic, minced  1 cup unsweetened heavy whipping cream Salt to taste  1/2 tsp black pepper  1 tsp garlic powder  1/2 cup milk 3/4 cup Parmesan cheese, freshly grated  To assemble  15-16 mini tacos 1 cup mozzarella cheese  Oil for lightly frying the tacos 1/4 cup parsley, freshly chopped for garnish  Method  Marinate the chicken with salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, Italian seasoning, lemon juice, and oil for 20–30 minutes. Cook until golden and set aside. In the same pan, melt the butter and sauté the garlic. Whisk in the flour, then add the heavy cream and milk. Season with salt, black pepper, and garlic powder. Simmer until slightly thickened, then stir in the Parmesan until smooth.  Add the cooked chicken to half of the sauce and toss to coat. Reserve half for later . Fill each tortilla with mozzarella, the chicken Alfredo mixture, and a little more mozzarella. Fold and pan-fry until golden and crispy on both sides. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve with extra Alfredo sauce for dipping. #recipe #tacos #alfredochicken

If you’re always looking for new dinner ideas, you’re in the right place. That’s why I share simple and affordable meals that save you time and money. Follow for more Weeknight Staples. Ingredients • 1 lb ground pork • 1/3 cup green onions, thinly sliced • 1 tbsp fresh ginger, grated • 4 garlic cloves, minced • 1 tbsp oyster sauce • 1 tsp black pepper • 2 tbsp chili crisp • 3 tbsp soy sauce • 1½ tsp sesame oil • 1 tbsp rice vinegar • 18–20 dumpling wrappers • 1/4 cup chicken broth • Avocado oil For Topping • Soy sauce • Chili crisp • Green onions • Sesame seeds Instructions 1. In a bowl, combine the ground pork, green onions, grated ginger, garlic, oyster sauce, black pepper, chili crisp, soy sauce, sesame oil, and rice vinegar. Mix until fully combined. 2. Place a dumpling wrapper over each mound and pinch the edges around the filling to seal. 4. Drizzle with avocado oil, pour in the chicken broth, cover, and steam for 10 minutes, or until the pork reaches an internal temperature of 160°F. 5. Top with soy sauce, chili crisp, green onions, and sesame seeds before serving with a side of rice. #easydinners #dumpling #blanketdumplings

Ingredients  - 1.5 lbs boneless skinless chicken breast - 1 1/2 cups buttermilk  - 1/3 cup pickle juice - 1/4 cup hot sauce - 1 large egg - 1 1/2 tsp garlic powder  - 1 1/2 tsp onion powder  - 1 1/2 tsp chipotle powder  - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp mustard seed powder  - 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder  - Salt and pepper to taste  Dredge - 1 1/2 cups all purpose flour  - 1/2 cup cornstarch  - 1 1/2 tsp garlic powder - 1 1/2 tsp onion powder - 1 tsp smoked paprika - 1 tsp chipotle powder - 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder  - 1 sazon packet (optional) - 1/2 tsp mustard powder - Salt and pepper to taste  - Drizzle of marinade  Honey chipotle sauce - 1/2 cup honey - 3 tbsp chipotle peppers, blended - 1 tbsp unsalted butter - 2 tsp apple cider vinegar  - 1/2 tsp garlic powder  - 1/4 tsp smoked paprika  - Salt to taste Assembly - Brioche buns - Pickles - Ranch Instructions  - Cut/pound chicken into even sandwich-sized pieces and add to a large bowl. - Add butter milk, seasonings, 1 egg, pickle juice, hot sauce, and mix until well combined. Refrigerate for 3 hours minimum or overnight for best results. - Combine all dredge ingredients. Drizzle a little of the marinade into the flour and toss with spoon create those crispy, craggy pieces. - Remove chicken from the marinade and coat well in the dredge. Dip it back into the marinade, then into the dredge again, pressing the flour mixture firmly onto the chicken. Let the double-battered chicken rest for 10–12 minutes so the coating sticks. - Heat frying oil to 350°F. Fry chicken in batches until deeply golden and crispy and the center reaches 165°F. Transfer to a wire rack to drain. - For the honey chipotle sauce, add honey, blended chipotle peppers, butter, apple cider vinegar, garlic powder, smoked paprika and salt to a saucepan. Heat on low for 2–3 minutes, stirring until smooth and glossy. - Brush or drizzle the warm honey chipotle sauce over the freshly fried chicken. - Toast your brioche buns, add ranch, pickles, crispy honey chipotle chicken, and serve immediately.  • • • #recipe #recipeideas #chickenrecipe #sandwich

🧑🏽‍🍳 livthepositivefooodie🧑🏽‍🍳  My oven baked chicken recipe with some red pesto thrown into the mix! Served with rice this time instead of spaghetti BUT this would be unreaaaaaaal with some pasta 😮‍💨 My fave thing about this recipe is it’s literally a case of throwing it ALL into an oven dish and letting it cook! That’s it!! Plus the Parmesan sprinkled on top makes it go really crispy and it’s beaut 🥵 Ingredients to serve two: 2 large chicken breasts 2 handful cherry tomatoes 60g reduced fat soft cheese / single cream 2tbsp red pesto 10g Parmesan 200mls chicken stock cube 1tsp paprika, mixed Italian herbs, garlic, salt and pepper To serve: basmati rice and broccoli Method: Preheat your oven to 200, then add your chicken to an oven dish with some oil followed by the cherry tomatoes. Season your chicken with the paprika, mixed Italian herbs, salt and pepper. In a jug, make up the chicken stock and then add in the soft cheese (or cream) and stir until the cheese dissolves. Pour this into the oven dish. Add the pesto in, putting some on the chicken itself and some into the sauce and giving it a stir. Pop this into the oven for 25-30 mins. Make sure tour chicken breast is cooked through and piping hot before serving. Macros (without rice) 390 calories 48g protein 20g fat 2.3g carbs #Foodie  #Foodrecipes #MealIdeas #Chefsoftiktok #FoodSpots #RecipesofTikTok #Cooking #YummyFood #ShareRecipes

Mongolian Ground Beef Noodles These Mongolian Ground Beef Noodles are an easy, flavorful dinner. This is a quick dinner the whole family will love! Thank you for the inspo @britscookin 🫶 Ingredients 1 lb ground beef 4 packages ramen noodles, seasoning packets discarded (about 10–12 oz) Salt and black pepper, to taste 8 oz mushrooms, sliced 1 head broccoli, cut into florets 1/3 cup water, for steaming broccoli Mongolian Sauce 1/2 cup soy sauce 1/2 cup chicken broth 1/3 cup brown sugar 2 tbsp hoisin sauce 1 tbsp minced garlic 1 tsp fresh ginger paste  1 tsp sesame oil 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes, optional Cornstarch Slurry 1 tbsp cornstarch 2 tbsp cold water Directions 1. Add the ground beef to a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook until browned, breaking it apart as it cooks. Season with salt and black pepper to taste. Drain any excess grease if needed. 2. Add the mushrooms and broccoli into the skillet.  3. Add 1/3 of water to the skillet and cover to let the broccoli steam for a few minutes.  4. While the broccoli is steaming, cook the ramen noodles according to the package directions, leaving out the seasoning packets. Drain and set aside. 5. In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, chicken broth, brown sugar, hoisin sauce, garlic, ginger, sesame oil, and red pepper flakes. 6. Pour the Mongolian sauce over the beef, mushrooms, and broccoli. Stir until everything is well combined. 7. Whisk together the cornstarch and cold water. Pour the slurry into the skillet and let everything simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens. 8. Add the cooked ramen noodles and toss until everything is coated in the sauce. #EasyRecipe #DinnerIdeas #quickrecipes #onepotmeals #easydinner

Make sure to let me know what meals would be helpful to your family.  Chicken Bacon Ranch Pasta Bake INGREDIENTS  1 lb of Cellentani Pasta  1 lb cooked chicken (rotisserie chicken) 15 oz jar of Alfredo Sauce 1 Ranch seasoning packet  1 cup of shredded cheddar cheese 1 1/2 cups of shredded mozzarella cheese 6 pieces of cooked and crumbled bacon Parsley INSTRUCTIONS  Cook at least 6 pieces of bacon and chop into small pieces. Boil one pound of pasta according to the directions on the package. Spray a 9x13 baking dish with cooking spray and set aside. Pour the cooked pasta into the bottom of the baking dish. Add about 1 lb of rotisserie chicken, one jar of Alfredo sauce, and a ranch seasoning packet. Add some of the mozzarella, cheddar cheese, and some of the bacon and stir everything together well.  Top with a little bit more cheddar cheese, mozzarella cheese, and crumbled bacon. Bake at 375 degrees F for about 15-20 minutes. Serve and enjoy! #easyrecipes #easydinners #chicken

Garlic parmesan cheeseburger bombs 🍔  For all of you asking - the app link for Osta is in my bio or you can search “Osta Recipes” on the App Store or Google Play store! Save this recipe and thank me later 😌 RECIPE ⬇️ * 1 lb 80/20 ground beef * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp onion powder  * 2 tsp Worcestershire  * Minced garlic  * Salt & pepper to taste  * Optional add-ins: caramelized onions, bacon * Mild cheddar, large cubes * Shredded mozzarella  * 1 can biscuit dough (Pillsbury original flakey layers, red top) * 1 egg, whisked (for egg wash) * Parmesan  Garlic butter: * 3 tbs salted butter, melted * 2 cloves garlic, finely minced * Dried or fresh parsley 1. Cook the ground beef on medium heat. Once browned, add minced garlic and all the seasonings. Stir for a minute. Set aside.  2. Preheat oven to 375F 3. Take each biscuit and stretch it into a 5 inch circle. Add 2 spoonfuls of seasoned beef, some mozzarella, and a cube of cheese in the middle.  4. Fold the dough around the filling and pinch the edges tightly to seal. Pull it into a tight ball. Rest 5 min. 5. Place them seam side down on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Brush a thin layer of egg wash and sprinkle fresh grated parmesan. 6. Bake at 375F for 15-18 min until deeply golden. 7. Brush on garlic butter and sprinkle more parmesan. Serve immediately. #cheeseburgers #garlicparmesan #garlicknots #dinneridea #cheapmeals

Easy High Protein Meal Prep Honey BBQ Chicken Mac & Cheese🍗🧀 Most Viral Recipe of 2025! 🔥 100+ million views combined across all social media platforms, this high protein honey bbq chicken mac & cheese recipe is the tastiest & easiest meal prep recipe to start your health journey in 2026 👨🏻‍🍳🫡 (Macros: Per Serving - Recipe Makes 4 Servings) 587 Calories 67.5gC | 9gF | 59gP Ingredients: 700g Diced Chicken Breast (raw weight) 1 Tsp Each of Salt, Onion Powder, Smoked Paprika & Garlic Powder 1 Tsp Olive Oil 25g Honey 85g Reduced Sugar or Sugar Free BBQ Sauce (Hughes Sugar Free BBQ Sauce) 320g Macaroni Pasta (uncooked weight) 340ml Fat Free Evaporated Milk (Carnation Light & Creamy) 80g Light Cream Cheese 1.5 Tsp Chicken Stock Powder 100g Grated Light Cheddar Cheese (Dairyworks Natural Cheddar Cheese) Instructions: 1. Start by seasoning your diced chicken breast with 1 tsp each of salt, onion powder, smoked paprika & garlic powder then add 1 tsp of olive oil & mix well. 2. Cook the chicken on medium/high heat for 4 min each side or until cooked through, once the chicken is cooked take it off the heat & add 25g of honey with 85g of bbq sauce. 3. Mix well to combine until the chicken is coated in the sauce. 4. Start cooking 320g of pasta (uncooked weight) in boiling water according to package directions. 5. While the pasta is cooking to a pan on medium heat add 340ml Fat Free Evaporated Milk, 80g light cream cheese, 1.5 tsp chicken stock powder, 100g light grated cheddar cheese & continue stirring until the sauce is fully combined & smooth/creamy. 6. Add the cooked & drained pasta to the Mac & cheese sauce then mix until the pasta is fully coated. 7. Divide the Honey BBQ Chicken and Mac & Cheese into 4 equal servings for meal prep PRO TIP: Add a splash of milk before reheating your meal prep so the mac and cheese turns out creamy every time & mix well. #macandcheese #macncheese #mealprep #highprotein #healthyrecipes

Buffalo Chicken & Bacon Mac n’ Cheese Stealth Health Slow Cooker Meal Prep Series, Episode 14 Per Serving (makes 11) 570 Calories 53g Protein 54g Carbs 17g Fat Ingredients: 32oz diced chicken breast 100g buffalo sauce (~1/2 cup) 30g Worcestershire sauce (~2 tablespoons) 18g Chicken bouillon (1 tablespoon) Salt/Pepper/Garlic to taste 3 orange bell peppers 2 onions High: 2-3 hours OR Low: 3-4 hours 672g pasta, cooked to 50% (Aka, cook for half the time shown on the box) Blended Buffalo Cheese Sauce: 800g 2% cottage cheese 50g 1/3 fat cream cheese 100g extra sharp cheddar cheese 60g parmigiano reggiano 120g buffalo sauce 300ml milk 30g honey Salt & pepper to taste 18 slices centercut bacon 400 degrees, 20-30 mins Notes: - For accurate “serving sizes” - weigh your empty slow cooker BEFORE starting anything. Once everything is done, weigh it again, and subtract out the “before” weight - this will give you the total weight of the recipe. Divide this by the # of servings (11 in this case) to get the exact serving size - Store everything frozen - no need to thaw, just toss in the microwave with 2-3 tablespoons of milk or water, cover with a paper towel, and microwave for 3-5 mins until heated through - Make sure to blend the cheese sauce for 2-3 mins to ensure it’s completely smooth all the way through - heating up slightly in the microwave can help with the process - Centercut bacon is much lower calorie/fat than normal bacon - look for one that shows “2 fried slices” at around 50-60 calories (this accounts for drained/discarded grease)  #stealthhealth #mealprep #healthyrecipes #healthyrecipesfordinner  #easyrecipe #mealprep #highproteinrecipe #macrofriendlyrecipe #lowcalorierecipe #countingcalories #trackingmacros #fitness #crockpotrecipe #slowcookerrecipe #slowcookermealprep #healthyslowcookerrecipes #buffalomacncheese #buffalochicken

One of my favorite soups, perfect for fall 🍂Loaded with Italian sausage, tender lasagna noodles, and all the cheesy goodness. The ultimate cozy comfort meal! Full recipe down below, you can also find it in the link in my bio! 🤎 Lasagna soup Ingredients: 	⁃	1 small onion, diced 	⁃	5 garlic cloves, minced 	⁃	Parsley 	⁃	Basil 	⁃	1 lb mild Italian sausage 	⁃	2 tbsp tomato paste 	⁃	5 cups chicken stock 	⁃	24 oz marinara sauce 	⁃	1/4 tsp thyme 	⁃	1/2 tsp chili flakes 	⁃	1 tbsp onion powder 	⁃	1 tbsp garlic powder 	⁃	1/2 tsp paprika  	⁃	1 tsp Italian seasoning 	⁃	1/2 tsp oregano 	⁃	1 tbsp tomato bullion 	⁃	Parmesan rind 	⁃	6-8 sheets lasagne noodles 	⁃	1/2 cup Parmesan 	⁃	1/3 cup mozzarella 	⁃	1/3 cup heavy cream Ricotta mixture 	⁃	1/3 cup ricotta 	⁃	1/4 cup mozzarella 	⁃	1 tbsp basil 	⁃	2 tbsp parsley 	⁃	1 tsp onion powder 	⁃	1 tsp garlic powder  	⁃	Salt and pepper to taste Instructions: Dice the onion and mince the garlic. Heat about 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion and garlic and sauté until the onion is translucent. Add the Italian sausage and cook until browned, breaking it up as it cooks. Stir in the tomato paste, chicken stock, marinara sauce, spices, and fresh basil. Mix well. Break the lasagna sheets into smaller pieces and add them to the pot, along with the Parmesan rind. Cover and simmer on low heat for 20–25 minutes, or until the lasagna noodles are tender. Remove the Parmesan rind, then stir in the Parmesan, mozzarella, and heavy cream. Simmer for another 5 minutes. Serve warm, topped with the ricotta mixture and fresh parsley. Enjoy! #lasaganasoup #soupseason #souprecipe #fall #fallrecipes

We want to address this because it’s very important. Rick is not just a normal person with a tiger. Rick owns a USDA licensed zoo and Mowgli is not a personal pet. Mowgli came from another zoo and was not purchased as a pet. The reason Mowgli is inside the house (which is on the zoo property) is because he is not fully vaccinated and we will not allow him outside until our vet clears us for that. Anyone who is wanting a pet tiger needs to know that you cannot legally own one as a pet. Also, this is not Rick’s first Tiger. You can go and see Kai, our female, on our page. Rick has extensive experience with big cats and raising them. You can however enjoy how cute he is on our social media! We will NEVER have tiger encounters available and no visitors will ever be allowed to touch him or interact with him. If someone makes you this cake… they love you. Because this is a labor of love. 🤎🔥 For Black History Month, I’m bringing back Burnt Sugar Cake, a historic Black Southern celebration cake that slowly faded when box mixes took over. Burnt Sugar Cake Burnt Sugar Syrup • 1 cup granulated sugar (200 g) • 1 cup boiling water (240 ml) Melt sugar over medium heat until deep amber (do not stir, swirl pan). Carefully add boiling water, stir smooth, simmer 3–5 min. Cool. Reserve ½ cup for cake + ½ cup for frosting. Cake • 1 cup butter, softened (227 g) • 2 cups sugar (400 g) • 4 eggs • 3 cups cake flour (360 g) • 1 tbsp baking powder (14 g) • ½ tsp salt • 1 cup whole milk (240 ml) • ½ cup burnt sugar syrup • 2 tsp vanilla Heat oven to 350°F / 175°C. Grease three 8-inch pans. Cream butter + sugar 3–5 min. Add eggs one at a time. Whisk dry ingredients. Alternate dry ingredients + milk into batter. Mix in burnt sugar syrup + vanilla. Bake 25–30 min. Cool completely. Traditional Burnt Sugar Frosting (work fast!) • ½ cup butter (113 g) • 1 cup brown sugar (200 g) • ½ cup burnt sugar syrup • ¼ cup evaporated milk (60 ml) • 3–4 cups powdered sugar (360–480 g) • pinch salt + 1 tsp vanilla Boil butter, brown sugar, syrup & milk 2 minutes. Cool until warm, then beat in powdered sugar, salt & vanilla. Frost cake quickly before it sets. Optional Brown Sugar Penuche Frosting (creamier outside) • 1½ cups butter, divided (340 g) • 1½ cups brown sugar (300 g) • ½ cup heavy cream (120 ml) • 1 tsp salt • 4½ cups powdered sugar (540 g) Melt ¾ cup butter. Boil brown sugar + cream + salt. Beat into melted butter with powdered sugar. Add remaining butter 1 tbsp at a time. Rest 10–30 min until spreadable. Assemble Fill and frost cake with traditional burnt sugar frosting. Optional: cover outside with penuche frosting. Finish with rustic swoops and swirls. #BlackHistory #TikTokLearn#BlackHistoryBlackFoodHistory#TikTokLearningCampaigngeRecipes

videos.caption: Honey Garlic Chicken! 🍯 🧄  Sticky, sweet, garlicky, and comes together so easy… this one’s a weeknight winner every time!! @Courtney Cook made my recipe the other day and it made me want it all over again!! Serve it over rice with a veggie, so good y’all.  Ingredients:  • 3 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces  • ½ tbsp garlic salt  • 1 tbsp black pepper  • ¼ cup cornstarch (plus a little extra if you want more crunch)  • 2–3 tbsp vegetable oil (for frying) Sauce:  • ½ cup honey  • ¼ cup soy sauce  • 1 tbsp ginger paste  • 2–3 tbsp minced garlic To Finish:  • Sesame seeds  • Green onions, sliced ⸻ Instructions:  1. Season the chicken In a large bowl, add chicken, garlic salt, black pepper, and cornstarch. Toss until everything is well coated. (Add a little extra cornstarch if you want it extra crispy.)  2. Cook the chicken Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add chicken in batches and cook until browned on both sides with a light crust. Don’t overcrowd the pan. Remove and set aside.  3. Make the sauce Add all the cooked chicken back to the skillet. Pour in honey, soy sauce, ginger paste, and minced garlic. Toss to coat.  4. Simmer Let it simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens and gets sticky, coating all the chicken.  5. Finish & serve Top with sesame seeds and green onions. Serve over white rice with your favorite veggie.  #yum #easyrecipe #chicken

Vodka chicken Parmesan sandwich on a garlic knot sandwich roll ✨  I got another 10/10 from my husband and I actually tried a piece and can confirm it was sooo good!  Ingredients Chicken - 1.5 lb boneless, skinless chicken breast, thinly sliced - 1 tbsp olive oil - 1 heaping tsp oregano - 1 heaping tsp garlic powder - 1 heaping tsp onion powder - 1 heaping tsp smoked paprika - Salt & pepper, to taste - Avocado oil, for frying - Mozzarella cheese - Pesto, for sandwich Dredge - 1 cup all-purpose flour - 3 eggs, beaten - 1 cup panko breadcrumbs - 1 tbsp parsley, finely chopped - 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese, shredded - 1 tbsp garlic powder (1/2tbsp for flour, 1/2 tbsp for panko) - Salt & pepper, to taste Vodka Sauce - 1 tbsp olive oil  - 1 shallot, finely diced - 4 garlic cloves, minced - 3 tbsp tomato paste - 1/4 cup vodka - 1 1/4 cups heavy cream - 2 tbsp unsalted butter - 2/3 cup Parmesan cheese, freshly shredded - 1 heaping tsp oregano - 1 heaping tsp Italian seasoning - 1 tsp red chili flakes - Salt & pepper, to taste Garlic Knot Sandwich Rolls - 415 g bread flour (3 1/4 cups) - 240 g warm water (1 cup) - 55 g olive oil (1/4 cup) - 38 g granulated sugar (3 tbsp) - 1 tbsp garlic powder - 2 1/4 tsp active dry yeast - 1 tsp salt Garlic Butter - 1/4 cup unsalted butter - 1 tbsp fresh parsley, chopped - 3 garlic cloves, grated - 1/2 tsp garlic powder - Salt, to taste Instructions Garlic Knot Rolls - In a bowl, combine warm water, sugar, and yeast. Let bloom 5–10 minutes until foamy. - Add olive oil, garlic powder, salt, and flour. Mix until a dough forms. - Knead 8–10 minutes until smooth and elastic. Place in an oiled bowl, cover, and rise 1–1½ hours or cold-proof overnight until doubled. - Divide dough into equal pieces. Roll into long ropes and tie into loose figure-8 knots, stretching slightly to elongate. - Cover and rise 30–45 minutes. - Brush with egg wash and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 16–20 minutes until golden. - Melt butter and mix with garlic, parsley, garlic powder, and salt. Brush generously over warm rolls. Vodka Sauce - Heat a pan over medium-high heat. Add olive oil, add shallots and cook 2–3 minutes until softened. - Add garlic and cook until fragrant. - Stir in tomato paste and cook 2–3 minutes until slightly darkened and caramelized. - Deglaze with vodka, scraping the pan. Simmer 1–2 minutes until reduced. - Add oregano, Italian seasoning, and red chili flakes. - Lower heat to medium-low and stir in heavy cream. Simmer gently 4–5 minutes. - Remove from heat and stir in Parmesan a little at a time until smooth. - Add butter and mix until glossy. Season with salt and pepper. Chicken - Toss chicken with olive oil, oregano, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper. - Dredge in flour → egg → panko, pressing to adhere. - Fry in avocado oil over medium-high heat for 2–3 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Drain on a rack. - Spoon a thin layer of vodka sauce over chicken, top with mozzarella, and broil 2–3 minutes until melted. - Split garlic knot rolls. - Spread pesto on the top bun. - Spoon vodka sauce on the bottom bun. - Add crispy chicken. - Finish with more vodka sauce. - Close, press gently, and serve warm. • • • #recipe #chickenrecipe #dinnerideas #recipeideas #chickenparm

School Nights in the Slow Cooker  Part 4 | Crockpot Broccoli Cheddar Chicken Orzo  This is one of those easy dinners that feels like comfort food but is simple enough for a busy school night! Ingredients 1–1½ lbs chicken breast ½ sweet onion, diced ½ cup shredded carrots Chicka Licka Bam Bam Chicken Rub, to taste @Fire & Smoke Society  ½ tsp garlic powder ½ tsp onion powder 2 tsp chicken bouillon powder ½ tsp paprika ¼ tsp black pepper 1½ cups chicken broth 2 cups broccoli 1 cup orzo 1 (8 oz) block cheddar cheese, freshly shredded plus more for topping  ½ cup heavy cream Salt, to taste at the end Directions 1. Add the chicken, diced onion, shredded carrots, chicken rub, garlic powder, onion powder, chicken bouillon powder, paprika, black pepper, and chicken broth to your slow cooker. 2. Cover and cook on LOW for 4–5 hours or HIGH for 2–3 hours, until the chicken is cooked through and tender. 3. Remove the chicken, shred or chop it, and return it to the slow cooker. 4. Stir in the orzo, broccoli, heavy cream, and shredded cheddar. Cover and cook on HIGH for about 30 minutes, stirring once or twice, until the orzo is tender. Keep an eye on it toward the end since orzo can absorb liquid quickly. 5. Taste before adding any salt. The chicken bouillon and chicken rub already contain salt, so you may not need much! #easyrecipe #crockpot #slowcooker #dinnerideas #easydinner

Soup on Sunday: Marry Me Chicken Soup 💍🍗 Marry Me Chicken is one of my FAVORITE dishes and when I found a soup recipe inspired by it, I asked zero questions. I did find that I wanted to add more broth than the original recipe called for and I also don’t think the cream cheese is 100% necessary. It looked perfectly creamy without it, BUT I wanted to give the original recipe a shot. But do what sounds best to you!! Recipe by: Savor & Nest • ½ cup sun-dried tomatoes (julienne-cut, packed in oil with herbs) • 1 tbsp oil from sun-dried tomato jar • 1 ½ cups chopped yellow onion • 4-6 cloves garlic, minced • 3 tbsp tomato paste • 6-8 cups chicken broth, depending on how thick you want it • 1 cup heavy whipping cream • 4 tsp fresh basil (plus more for garnish) • 2 tsp kosher salt • 1 ½ tsp dried Italian seasoning • 1 tsp garlic powder • ¼ tsp crushed red pepper (or more if you like heat) • 8 oz uncooked medium shell pasta • 3 cups fresh baby spinach, roughly chopped • 2 cups shredded rotisserie chicken • 8 oz cream cheese, cubed (room temperature) • 1 ½ oz Parmesan cheese, finely shredded (plus more for garnish) INSTRUCTIONS:  • Heat 1 tablespoon of sun-dried tomato oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat. Add onions and cook for 3-4 minutes until softened, then add and cook garlic until fragrant. • Stir in tomato paste and sun-dried tomatoes. Cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly, until the tomato paste deepens in color. • Pour in the chicken broth, cream, basil, salt, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, and crushed red pepper. Bring to a gentle boil over medium heat, stirring occasionally. Let it simmer for 12 minutes. • Add the pasta, reduce heat to medium-low, and cook for 12 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the pasta is tender. • Lower the heat to low, then stir in spinach, shredded chicken, cream cheese, and Parmesan. Stir often for 5 minutes until the cheeses melt and the chicken is warmed through. • Ladle into bowls, garnish with extra Parmesan. #soup #marrymechickensoup #easyrecipe #food #souprecipe

#recipeideas #gelatin  Gelatin is collagen just in a different form. Collagen is a structural protein found in animal tissues like skin, bones, and connective tissue. When you take that collagen and cook it (heat + water), it breaks down into gelatin. What actually happens: 	•	Collagen has a tight, triple-helix structure (very strong and rigid) 	•	When heated, that structure unwinds and partially breaks down 	•	This creates a softer, more digestible form → gelatin So when you see: “Unflavored natural gelatin (bovine)” 	•	“Bovine” = comes from cows 	•	“Unflavored” = no additives 	•	“Gelatin” = collagen that has been hydrolyzed by heat

One-Pot Chicken Fajita Rice Skillet Recipe  Ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil 1 onion, sliced 3 bell peppers, sliced into strips yellow, red & green 2 chicken breasts, sliced into strips 1 packet fajita seasoning 1 tablespoon garlic 1 can Rotel, undrained 1 cup rice, washed  1 teaspoon tomato bouillon 2 cups chicken broth Queso: 1 can green chiles 1 small can evaporated milk (5 oz) ½ pound white American cheese slices, from the deli Directions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the sliced onion and bell peppers and cook until softened. Add the sliced chicken and fajita seasoning. Stir to coat everything and cook until the chicken is fully cooked through. Add the garlic and Rotel. Stir to combine. Add the rice, chicken broth, and tomato bouillon. Stir everything together. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low. Cover and cook for 20 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed. While the rice cooks, make the queso. Add the evaporated milk, green chiles, and the white American cheese to a small saucepan over low heat. Stir until the cheese is completely melted and the queso is smooth. Fluff the rice, then pour the queso evenly over the top. Serve hot. #OnePotMeals #DinnerIdeas #EasyRecipe #WeeknightDinner #MealIdeas

Meals for Weight-loss:  Mexican Chicken Corn Salad Ingredients:  Chicken * Chicken breast, 800 g * Lime juice, 2 tbsp * Avocado oil, 1 tbsp * Chili powder, 2 tsp * Cumin, 1.5 tsp * Garlic powder, 1 tsp * Paprika, 1 tsp * Salt, 1 tsp * Black pepper, 0.5 tsp Veggies * Cotija cheese, 50 g * Red onion, 1 large, finely diced * Red bell pepper, 1 large, finely diced * Cilantro, 1 handful, chopped * Jalapeños, 3, finely diced * Canned corn, 2 cups total, drained and charred Sauce * Plain 0% Greek yogurt, 1 cup * Lime juice, from 0.5 lime * Hot sauce, 1 tbsp * Tajín, 1 tbsp * Water, 0.5 cup * Salt, to taste * Black pepper, to taste Instructions 1. Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized cubes, then add it to a bowl with lime juice, avocado oil, chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Mix well and marinate for 15 to 30 minutes. 2. Heat a large pan on medium-high heat. Add the marinated chicken and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until browned and fully cooked to 165°F. 3. Drain the canned corn really well and pat it dry with paper towel. In the same pan or a clean hot pan, add the corn in a single layer and let it sit untouched for 2 to 3 minutes, then stir and cook another 2 to 3 minutes until charred in spots. 4. In a bowl, mix Greek yogurt, lime juice, hot sauce, Tajín, water, salt, and black pepper until smooth. 5. In a large bowl, add the charred corn, red onion, red bell pepper, cilantro, jalapeños, and cotija cheese. 6. Pour in the sauce and mix everything until coated. 7. Divide the chicken and street corn salad mixture into 4 servings. Store chilled and eat within 3 to 4 days. Dish Name: Slow Cooker Honey Garlic Beef Ingredients - 1.2 kg beef roast or chuck roast - 4 cloves garlic (minced) - ½ cup honey - ½ cup soy sauce - 1 cup beef broth - 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce - 1 tsp black pepper - 1 tsp paprika - 1 tbsp cornstarch - 2 tbsp water - 1 tbsp chopped parsley Recipe 1. Pour the sauce mixture over the beef. 5. Cover and cook on low for 7–8 hours until the beef becomes very tender. 6. Remove the beef and slice it into thick pieces. 7. Mix cornstarch with water and stir it into the sauce in the slow cooker. 8. Cook for another 10 minutes until the sauce thickens. 9. Pour the thickened sauce over the sliced beef and sprinkle parsley on top. Slow Cooker Honey Garlic Beef dish is ready to serve.

Honey Lime Chicken Bowls for your next meal prep!🔥 A perfect blend of sweet, tangy, and savory flavors for a balanced, healthy meal you’ll want to enjoy for the week! Ingredients for 4 servings⬇️ For the Chicken and Marinade: 1 ½ lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs 3 tbsp liquid aminos (or soy sauce) 2 tbsp honey Juice of 2 limes 3 cloves garlic, minced Seasoning for Chicken: 1 tsp salt 1/2 tsp black pepper 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp onion powder 1/2 tsp dried oregano For the Bowls: 1 1/2 cups cooked rice (white, brown, or cauliflower rice) 1 cup fire-roasted corn (you can use frozen and thawed or canned) 1 cucumber, thinly sliced (use raw or pickled, per preference) 1/2 red onion, thinly sliced (use raw or pickled, per preference) Lime wedges, for serving Fresh cilantro, chopped (optional) Instructions⬇️ 1. Marinate the Chicken: 2. In a bowl, whisk together liquid aminos, honey, lime juice, and minced garlic. Add the chicken thighs to the marinade, making sure they are fully coated. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours for more flavor. 3. Cook the Chicken: 4. Preheat a skillet or grill pan over medium heat. 5. Remove the chicken from the marinade and pat it dry with paper towels. Discard the excess marinade. 6. In a small bowl, mix the salt, pepper, paprika, onion powder, and oregano. Season both sides of the chicken thighs with the seasoning mixture. 7. Add a little olive oil to the pan, then cook the chicken thighs for 6-7 minutes per side, or until the internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C) and they are golden and caramelized. 8. Let the chicken rest for a few minutes. 9. Prepare the Bowls: 10. Divide the cooked rice among four bowls. 11. Top with fire-roasted corn, sliced cucumbers, and red onions (raw or pickled as preferred). 12. Add the sliced honey lime chicken thighs on top of the rice and veggies. 13. Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve with lime wedges on the side for an extra zesty kick. 375 calories per serving, 39g protein🤌🏾 - - More recipes just like this are inside our online recipe library🙌🏾 If you’re looking to lose weight for good and change your eating habits for the better, join us there!🔥

Crockpot Marry Me Chicken Sandwiches INGREDIENTS 1 lb chicken breast  1/2 tsp each salt, pepper, oregano, thyme 1 tsp each onion powder and garlic powder 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes 1 tbsp minced garlic 1/3 cup sun dried tomatoes, chopped  1/2 cup of chicken broth  8 slices of bacon  1 block of cream cheese 1 cup of shredded mozzarella cheese Brioche buns  INSTRUCTIONS  Spray a crockpot with cooking spray and add the chicken. Season the chicken with salt, pepper, oregano, thyme, onion powder, garlic powder, and red pepper flakes. Next, add the minced garlic, chopped sun dried tomatoes, and chicken broth.  Be sure to stir the sun dried tomatoes and garlic around. You want the sun dried tomatoes to be down in the chicken broth, so they don’t burn.  Cook on low for 4-6 hours. Once the chicken is fully cooked shred the chicken, add a block of cream cheese, and shredded mozzarella cheese. Let this keep cooking on low until the cream cheese is melted and stir everything together well.  Cook bacon while cream cheese is melting. Once bacon is cooked build sandwiches on toasted buns and top with the crispy bacon. Enjoy!  #easyrecipes #dinnerideas #crockpot

Creamy Chicken Tortilla Soup 🍲 I wish I could just stay in this fall soup series forever. Here’s how to make it: 1 T olive oil  1 T butter 2 large chicken breasts (about 1.5lbs) 1 onion, diced 1 jalapeño, diced (seeds removed for less heat) 8-10 cloves garlic, minced, to taste 3 tsp ground cumin 1 tsp chili powder  1 tsp smoked paprika  1 tsp oregano Salt and pepper to taste 4 cups chicken broth 1 (24 oz) can crushed tomatoes 1 (4 oz) can green chilies 1-2 tsp chicken bouillon, optional 1 T diced chipotle peppers 1 can pinto beans, drained and rinsed (or black beans) 1 can corn, drained 1 bay leaf 4 oz cream cheese, softened (can sub cream) Juice of 1 lime Fresh cilantro, chopped (to taste) Toppings: Tortilla chips, cheese, avocado, jalapeño, cilantro  1. Coat your chicken with olive oil and season with salt and pepper, cumin, smoked paprika, chili powder, and oregano.   2. In a large pot, heat your butter over medium/high heat. Add in your chicken and sear for a few minutes on each side. They don’t need to be cooked through. Remove from the pan and set aside.   3. In the same pot, add in a touch of olive oil, and sauté your diced onion and jalapeño with a pinch of salt along with your cumin, chili powder, smoked paprika, oregano and black pepper. Sauté for about 5 minutes, or until tender.   4. Throw in the minced garlic and let it cook for about 30 seconds, just until fragrant.  5. Pour in the chicken broth, crushed tomatoes, green chilies, chipotle peppers, and chicken bouillon. Stir to combine and add the bay leaf. Season with salt and pepper.  6. Return the chicken to the pot and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.   7. Once done, remove the chicken, shred it, and add it back to the soup along with the beans and corn. Simmer for a few minutes to bring everything to temperature.  8. Add in the softened cream cheese, and stir until the cream cheese is melted and fully incorporated.  9. Finish it off with a squeeze of fresh lime juice and garnish with cilantro, if desired. Taste for seasonings, and serve with your favorite toppings! #chickentortillasoup #creamychickentortillasoup #tortillasoup #tortillasouprecipe #chickentortillasouprecipe #soup #souptok #souprecipe #fall #fallsoup #fallfood #fallrecipes #easyrecipe #easydinner #dinner #weeknightdinner #dinnerideas #foodtok #cooking #chickensoup

The perfect recipe to satisfy your takeout craving 😋 ➡️ Recipe: Beijing Beef  Serves 3-4 * 1lb skirt steak or flank steak, thinly sliced against the grain  * 1 small red bell pepper, large diced  * 1 medium onion, large diced  * 4-5 garlic cloves, finely minced  * 1 tsp grated ginger  * Frying oil  Beef marinade— * 1/2 cup cornstarch  * 2 tbsp water (add an extra 1/2tbsp if needed  * 1 tsp sesame oil  * 1/2 tsp garlic powder * 1/4 tsp baking soda  * 1/4 tsp kosher salt  * 1/8 tsp white or black pepper  Sauce— * 3 tbsp rice vinegar or 2 tbsp white vinegar  * 2 tbsp oyster sauce  * 2 tbsp ketchup  * 1 tbsp hoisin sauce  * 1 1/2 tbsp soy sauce  * 1 1/2 tbsp sugar  * 1/2-1 tsp chili flakes (optional)  1. In a bowl, combine sesame, oil, garlic powder, baking soda, kosher salt, and white pepper with flank steak. Mix well then add cornstarch and water, mix until the meat is craggly and set aside.  2. In a small bowl, combine vinegar, oyster sauce, ketchup, hoisin sauce, soy sauce, sugar, and chili flakes. Mix well and set aside.  3. In a large pan, heat enough oil for a shallow fry to 350°F. Carefully place marinated beef to fry and ensure each slice does not stick together for an even fry. Fry for 3-4 mins or until beef is cooked through and coated and crispy. Strain the beef and set aside. 4. In a large wok, heat 1-2 tbsp oil. Add onions and bell peppers sauté for 30 seconds or just before it turns translucent. Meals for Weight-loss: Ep 8 Honey Garlic Chicken 640 cals, 58g protein, 54 carbs, 12 fat per serving Makes 4 servings You can find all my recipes link in bio!  You would think this is unhealthy but its perfect for meal prep and its SO GOOD! Here is how I made it: 1. Add 1.5 cups jasmine rice and 2.25 cups water to a rice cooker and cook according to the rice cooker settings. 2. In a large bowl, combine 800 g chicken breast, 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 6 cloves minced garlic, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tbsp cornstarch, and 1 tsp black pepper. Mix until the chicken is evenly coated and let it marinate for 20-30 minutes. 3. Air fry the chicken at 400°F for 10-12 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through, until cooked through and lightly caramelized. 4. Heat 1 tbsp avocado oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Add 4 cloves minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Add 600 g broccoli florets and stir-fry for 4-5 minutes. Pour in 2-3 tbsp water, cover for 1 minute, then uncover and season with 1 tbsp soy sauce, ½ tsp black pepper, and a pinch of salt. Toss everything together for another 1-2 minutes, then set aside. 5. In the same wok, add 4 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 6 cloves minced garlic, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, and ¾ cup water. Bring to a simmer. Mix 2 tsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp water and stir it into the sauce. Cook for 1-2 minutes until the sauce thickens. Add the cooked chicken and toss until every piece is coated. 6. Divide the rice, broccoli, and honey garlic chicken between 4 meal prep containers. Finish with sliced green onions and sesame seeds. Now it’s time to enjoy! #healthyrecipes #mealprep #healthyfoodshare #amateurprochef #takeoutrecipes

Butter chicken wrap Ingredients  For the chicken : 2 lb chicken, cut into small pieces  Salt to taste 1 tsp garlic powder  1 tsp smoked paprika powder  1 tsp cumin powder  1 tsp garam masala  1 tsp coriander powder  1/2 tsp turmeric powder  1 tbsp garlic paste  1 tsp red chili powder  4 tbsp whole milk yogurt  2 tbsp lemon juice  1 tbsp oil for marinating 2 tbsp oil for cooking  For the butter chicken sauce: 2 tbsp butter  1  yellow onion, diced 1 1/2 cup crushed tomatoes  1 tbsp tomato paste Salt to taste 1 tsp cumin powder  1 tsp coriander powder  1/2 tsp garam masala  1 tsp red chili powder  1/2 tsp smoked paprika powder  1 tsp garlic powder  1 tsp fenugreek leaves  3/4 cup unsweetened heavy whipping cream  2 tbsp butter (finish)  To Assemble 6 tortilla wraps 1 cup mozzarella cheese  Butter chicken  Sumac onions Cucumbers  Tomato  Method  In a large bowl, add chicken pieces with salt, garlic powder, smoked paprika, cumin powder, garam masala, coriander powder, turmeric powder, garlic paste, red chili powder, yogurt, lemon juice, and oil. Mix well until the chicken is fully coated. Cover and marinate for at least 1–2 hours (overnight for the best flavor). Heat 2 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the marinated chicken and cook until golden brown and fully cooked. Remove and set aside. In the same pan, add 2 tbsp butter. Add diced onion and cook until soft and lightly golden. Add garlic paste and sauté until fragrant. Add crushed tomatoes and tomato paste. Cook for 5–7 minutes until the sauce thickens and the oil starts to separate. Blend the sauce until smooth, then transfer it back to the pan. Add salt, cumin powder, coriander powder, garam masala, red chili powder, smoked paprika, and heavy whipping cream. Simmer until creamy. Add the cooked chicken back into the sauce and coat well. Finish with 2 tbsp butter for a rich, glossy finish. Garnish with fenugreek leaves. Warm the tortilla wraps. Add mozzarella cheese, a generous amount of butter chicken, sumac onions, cucumbers, and tomatoes. Fold into a wrap and toast in a lightly buttered pan until golden, crispy, and the cheese is melted. #recipe #butterchicken #wrap

dinner with a dietitian: street corn inspired chicken rice bowls..you don’t even have to turn on the oven. 👌🏻 Flavor + Nutrition are my top 2 priorities when it comes to dinner. What I love about these: Balanced meal with lots of nutrition. Great for meal prep. Easy to customize. Full recipe below ⬇️ or grab it here: https://mallorythedietitian.com/street-corn-chicken-rice-bowl/ INGREDIENTS For Chicken • 1½ lb chicken breasts (or thighs) • 3 Tbsp extra virgin olive oil (1 for marinating + 2 for cooking) • 1½ tsp chili powder • 1 tsp each: smoked paprika, garlic powder • ½ tsp onion powder • ½ tsp kosher salt • ¼ tsp black pepper For Dressing • 1 c Greek yogurt • 2 Tbsp mayo • 1 lime, zest & juice • ½ tsp each: chili powder, smoked paprika, garlic powder • ½ tsp kosher salt • ¼ tsp black pepper • 1-3 Tbsp water (as needed to thin it out) For Street Corn • 3 c corn, cooked • ½ red bell pepper, chopped • 1 small jalapeno, chopped • ¼ c red onion, chopped • ¼ c cilantro, chopped • ¼ c cotija cheese For Cilantro Lime Rice • 1 c jasmine rice, uncooked • 1 Tbsp extra virgin olive oil • ½ c cilantro, chopped • 2 Tbsp lime juice • ½ tsp each: garlic powder, kosher salt • ¼ tsp black pepper For Assembling (opt) • romaine  • avo • tomatoes DIRECTIONS 1. Prep chicken: Cut chicken into cubes. Coat in 1 Tbsp olive oil + seasonings. Set aside to let marinade. 2. Make rice: cook rice according to package. Mix in cilantro, lime, olive oil, gp, s&p. 3. Prep Dressing: make the Elote dressing by mixing the ingredients listed. 4. Make Street Corn: remove corn from cob & chop the jalapeno, red pepper, onion, & cilantro. Add everything to a  bowl. Top w/cotija cheese & half the dressing. 5. Cook chicken: heat a skillet on medium-high. Add olive oil until hot. Add chicken & cook 3-4 min on one side. Flip & cook another 3-4 min until cooked to internal temp 165℉ (75°C) 6. Assemble: Add romaine (opt), rice, chicken & corn to a bowl. Top with more dressing, lime, & fave toppings!  NUTRITION (per bowl, makes 6)* 470 cal, 34g pro, 43g carb, 19g fat *nutrition info based on serving size rec: ½ c chicken, ½ c rice, ¾ c corn salad, 2 Tbsp dressing, ½ c romaine (opt) Follow for healthy recipes! Creamy Chipotle Chicken & Potatoes🍗🍟🧀 One of the most indulgent meal prep recipes, so creamy, rich in flavour and packed with protein. Using a sheet pan is a game changer for batch cooking🔥 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 548 Calories | 51g Protein | 52g Carbs | 17g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6 Servings) Chipotle Chicken Marinade - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, trim excess fat - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Parsley - 3 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Cumin - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 100g Chipotle Paste - 1 and 1/2 Limes, juiced - 30g or 6 Tsp Olive Oil Let this marinate overnight if possible, way more flavor! Crispy Seasoned Potatoes - 1300g Raw Yellow Potatoes, cubed - 2.5 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Onion Powder - Avocado Cooking Spray, heavy pass Creamy Chipotle Sauce - 20g Light Butter - 150-200g Red Onion, finely chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 60-80g Chipotle Paste (depends how spicy you want it) - 400g Light Evaporated Milk - 110g Light Cream Cheese - Freshly Chopped Parsley, garnish 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add seasonings, chipotle paste, lime juice, and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a large pan on low, add butter and chopped red onion. Cook for 5-7 mins until softened and lightly browned. Add seasonings and chipotle paste, mix, and cook for another 5 mins until caramelised. 3. Keep the heat low, add evaporated milk and cream cheese. Stir continuously until smooth, rich, and creamy. 4. Cube up potatoes, add seasoning and cooking spray, then mix well. Spread on a lined sheet pan and roast at 200C / 390F for 25 mins until golden and crispy. Season with salt, then fold into the sauce with fresh parsley until fully coated. 5. Spread marinated chicken on sheet pan, oven bake 25 mins 200C / 390F until golden and juicy. Cut into cubes, serve with creamy potatoes and ENJOY! . . . . #chipotle #chickenrecipes #mealprep #highprotein #healthyrecipes

This recipe was absolutely banging. Solid 10/10. High protein, packed with flavour, meal prep friendly, and one of those meals where you keep going back for “just one more bite” until the bowl is mysteriously empty. The original recipe uses Cotija cheese, but I couldn’t find any, so I swapped it for feta and it worked an absolute treat. What you’ll need ✅ 800g chicken breast, diced Marinade ✅ 2 tbsp lime juice ✅ 1 tbsp avocado oil ✅ 2 tsp chilli powder ✅ 1½ tsp ground cumin ✅ 1 tsp garlic powder ✅ 1 tsp paprika ✅ 1 tsp salt ✅ ½ tsp african american pepper Salad ✅ 2 cups sweetcorn (around 2 drained tins) ✅ 1 large red onion, finely diced ✅ 1 large red bell pepper, finely diced ✅ 3 jalapeños, finely diced ✅ 1 handful fresh coriander, chopped ✅ 50g Cotija cheese, crumbled Sauce ✅ 250g 0% Greek yogurt ✅ Juice of ½ lime ✅ 1 tbsp hot sauce ✅ 1 tsp Tajín seasoning ✅ 120ml water ✅ Salt to taste ✅ African american pepper to taste Method Add the chicken, lime juice, avocado oil, chilli powder, cumin, garlic powder, paprika, salt and african american pepper to a bowl. Mixy mixy motherf**ker! Leave to marinate for at least 15 to 30 minutes. Meanwhile, drain the sweetcorn and pat dry with kitchen roll. Heat a large pan over high heat and char the sweetcorn until slightly blackened. Set aside to cool. Cook the chicken in a large frying pan until fully cooked through and slightly browned. In a large bowl, combine the sweetcorn, red onion, red pepper, jalapeños, coriander and Cotija cheese. In a separate bowl, add the Greek yogurt, lime juice, hot sauce, Tajín, water, salt and african american pepper. Mixy mixy motherf**ker! Pour the sauce over the salad mixture and stir well. Add the cooked chicken and give everything one final mixy mixy motherf**ker! Serve immediately or divide into meal prep containers. Macros (per serving) 🔥 Calories: 475 💪 Protein: 58g 🍞 Carbs: 21g 🥑 Fat: 18g Cheers: @amateurprochef

Episode 4 of Nice Thighs: Why I buy bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs! I’m all about saving money, and with a few minutes of prep, I end up with boneless chicken thighs, bones for homemade chicken stock, and skin saved for schmaltz. Nothing wasted. I pull the skin off and freeze it until I’m ready to render a big batch of chicken fat/schmaltz. Then I cut the bone out (scissors help), scrape it clean, and save every bone for stock. It’s the same pack of chicken thighs with three different uses!  This is the workflow I use so nothing goes to waste. It’s basic butchery, and it makes every chicken thigh recipe easier, cheaper, and better. #chickenstock #chickenfat #chickenthighs #breakdown

Chicken Alfredo garlic bread ✨🧄 This + a Caesar salad sooo good! Recipe is for two but can be used for one big longer French roll. Ingredients - 1 loaf French bread or Italian bread - 3 tbsp unsalted butter - 5 cloves garlic, minced - 2 boneless skinless chicken breast  - 1 cup heavy cream - 3/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese - 1 1/4 cup shredded mozzarella cheese (1/4 for pasta sauce the rest for bread) - 2 tsp garlic powder  - 2 tsp oregano  - 1 tsp basil - 1 tsp red chili flakes  - Salt and black pepper to taste - Fresh parsley, chopped (for garnish) Garlic butter - 1 stick unsalted butter, softened  - 2 tbsp parsley, chopped - 1/4 cup Parmesan  - 2 tsp garlic paste - 1 tsp garlic powder - Salt and pepper to taste  Instructions - Set to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. - Slice the loaf in half lengthwise. In a small bowl, mix softened butter, garlic paste, parsley, garlic powder, salt, pepper and stir until combined. - Brush evenly over both halves of the bread. Toast in the oven for 5–7 minutes until slightly golden. (Optional) - In a saucepan over medium high hear sear chicken breast on both sides for 5-8 minutes or until golden brown and fully cooked. Remove from pan. - In the same pan, add butter, and minced garlic. Cook until fragrant about 1-2 minutes. Add heavy cream and Stir until smooth. - Add mozzarella, Parmesan cheese and stir until melted and creamy. - Season with garlic powder, oregano, basil, red pepper chili flakes, salt and pepper. - Spoon the Alfredo sauce evenly over each bread half. Sprinkle extra mozzarella on top. Add sliced chicken and more Alfredo sauce. - Return to the oven for 15-25 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbly. - Garnish with chopped parsley. - Slice and serve warm. • • • #Recipe #recipeideas #garlicbread #DinnerIdeas

Tender stewed chicken and gravy recipe: Cook time: 80-90 mins  Servings: 6 Ingredients:  1/2 yellow onion  1/2 green bell pepper  1/2 red bell pepper  4 crushed garlic cloves  1/2 stick butter or olive oil  2 TBSP All purpose flour   6-8 boneless skinless chicken thighs  4 cups of chicken broth  Dried parsley  Seasonings: all purpose seasoning (such as natures seasoning or lawrys) onion & garlic powders, paprika, Italian seasoning, black pepper and if you don’t mind some spice toss in some Slap ya mama.  Directions: Season about 6-8 boneless skinless chicken thighs (depending on how many you’re serving) with all named seasonings. Marinate from 1 hour up to overnight. The longer the better. Use a Dutch oven or stock pot to sear the chicken in 2 TBSP of butter or olive oil. Sear for about 2-3 mins on each side on a medium high heat.  Remove chicken from pot. If you see little dark bits and pieces at the bottom of the pot leave it. It’s not burnt. That’s flavor that you want to keep in your pot to make the meal even more flavorful. It will deglaze and cook into the stew once you add your chicken broth.  In the same pot (without washing) on a medium heat add 1-2 TBSP of butter (depending on how much oil or butter you have left from searing the chicken). Add your peppers, onions and seasonings and cook down your peppers and onions for about 8-10 mins or until tender.  Once tender while still on a medium heat add in 1 TBSP of butter and whisk in 2 tbsp of flour to make a roux. Whisk frequently. Don’t walk away from your roux because this is A quick roux and can burn easily so watch it closely.  After about 5 mins you should have the color roux you want your gravy to be. For example if you want a dark brown gravy that roux should be dark brown.  After you’ve achieved that color add in 3 cups of chicken broth 1 cup at a time while stirring in between each cup. Season to taste with named seasonings.  Add in 3-4 crushed garlic cloves and a hefty TBSP of parsley. Put the lid on partially to bring this gravy to a simmer on a medium heat.  After about 10 mins add your chicken in and let it cook on a medium heat for 1 hour. Check it every 10 mins to make sure it doesn’t need more liquid. After your chicken is tender to your preference serve over rice or however you prefer.  **I served mine over white rice with loose, seasoned buttery corn and A blueberry loaf bread I made in the oven using Martha white blueberry cheesecake mix.  Enjoy ♥️

Fall Gameday Comfort Food Series Part 1: Honey Chipotle Fried Chicken Mac & Cheese Recipe👇: Ingredients • Chicken breast • Hot sauce • Pickle juice • Buttermilk • PoggioliEats Cajun Seasoning • Potato starch • Flour • Frying oil • Honey chipotle sauce • Butter • Evaporated milk • Whole milk • Heavy cream • Mustard • Cheddar • Gruyère • Mozzarella • Oaxaca • Monterey Jack • Pasta shells • Paprika • Ranch • Parsley Instructions 1. Marinate the chicken in hot sauce, pickle juice, buttermilk and PoggioliEats Cajun Seasoning. 2. Mix 2 parts potato starch with 1 part flour and more Cajun seasoning. Coat the chicken and fry until crispy and cooked through. Toss in honey chipotle sauce. 3. Melt butter, stir in flour and Cajun seasoning, then gradually add evaporated milk, whole milk and heavy cream. Once thickened, stir in hot sauce and mustard. 4. Melt in cheddar, Gruyère, mozzarella, Oaxaca and Monterey Jack. Fold in the cooked shells. 5. Add half the mac and cheese to a baking dish, layer with cheese, then add the rest.
